title: POST /v1/windows request body
description: Spec IV.1 request body. Field names and types transcribed from the spec. Fields the spec gives a default for are optional; target, date_range and vehicle_profile_id are required.

type.description: LEO, POLAR, SSO and CUSTOM resolve as described in spec IV.1 type mapping.

h_t_km.description: Target altitude in km. Required and non-null when type is CUSTOM.

i_t_deg.description: Target inclination in degrees. Required and non-null when type is CUSTOM.

raan_deg.description: Right ascension of the ascending node in degrees. Null means any reachable plane.

ltan_hours.description: Local time of the ascending node, for example "10:30". SSO only.

site.description: Named site in config/. Defaults to "canso".

corridor.description: Optional corridor override. Without it the environmental assessment configuration is used.

criteria_version.description: Weather criteria version. Null means the current data/criteria_v*.json.

raan_tolerance_deg.description: RAAN tolerance in degrees. Null means the default for the target class.

include_weather.description: Whether the weather layer contributes to p_success.
